title: Carry earlier corrections and discarded-changes note into retry briefs
summary: When a user says "try again on <job>", the reader brief should also include the one-line corrections the user made to that job's earlier readings, and say plainly that the rejected attempt's changes were discarded and nothing from it is in the repository. Today `carry` passes only the request, findings and failed checks, so the user has to repeat corrections.

defaults_applied.how: New behavior gets unit tests; cargo test and clippy must pass.
One focused change to the retry carry path and brief rendering.
Doc comments on the new field and the brief wording are written for an outside reader.
Carried correction text goes through the redactor.
The cited interventions' content was inferred from the code: retries carry findings but not corrections or the discard fact.

assumptions: The job's recorded corrections (job.corrections, with their reading numbers) are the corrections to keep; interventions are reached through them.
Only the retried job's own corrections are carried; if the retried job was itself a retry, corrections on earlier jobs in the chain are not followed.
The corrections are quoted data and pass through the redactor, like the other carried text.
The producer-side retry (the code agent's brief) is out of scope; this concerns the reader brief that 'try again on' builds, which is where the cited interventions arose.
Landed changes are never in a rejected job, so stating that the changes were discarded is always true for rejected and failed jobs.

acceptance_criteria.text: EarlierAttempt in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs gains a field holding the earlier job's corrections (reading number and text), and reader_brief renders them in the Earlier attempt section as quoted data, saying they still apply unless the new request contradicts them.
reader_brief's Earlier attempt section states that the rejected or failed attempt's changes were discarded and are not in the repository, so the reader must not assume any of that work exists.
carry in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs fills the corrections from job.corrections in reading order and redacts them with the same redactor as the other carried text.
Every other construction of EarlierAttempt (referenced_jobs in reading.rs, tests in briefs.rs) compiles, and referenced jobs are unchanged in meaning.

New unit tests in briefs.rs cover the corrections and the discarded-changes sentence being present, and absent corrections adding no empty section. A reading.rs test shows earlier_attempt carries a redacted correction. Run `cargo test` and it passes.
`cargo clippy --all-targets` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.

out_of_scope: Changing the producer or verifier briefs.
Following corrections through a whole chain of retries.
Changing the 'try again on' syntax or which job states can be retried.
Governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, CI, lint config).
departures: None beyond the reference; the change is small but touches a shared struct used in several tests.
